title: Reverse Nodes in K-Group - Solution
approach: Recursive or iterative block traversal + local reverse.
intuition: Given a linked list, reverse the nodes of a linked list k at a time and return its modified head.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Recursive or iterative block traversal + local reverse.
code:
def solution(head, k):
    curr = head
    count = 0
    while curr and count < k:
        curr = curr.next
        count += 1
    if count == k:
        prev = None
        curr = head
        for _ in range(k):
            nxt = curr.next
            curr.next = prev
            prev = curr
            curr = nxt
        head.next = solution(curr, k)
        return prev
    return head
common_mistakes: Verify that at least k nodes exist before reversing. If not, keep original order.
